scope: Work, learning, employee, table, inbox, canvas, catalogue-card and brand families
method: All 16 assigned families and 4 brand nodes inspected through high-fidelity get_design_context responses and returned screenshots. Supplemental child-node contexts were inspected for exact task, work and employee sizing. No sparse response was used as implementation authority.
classification: Reusable presentation and interaction components; record examples live only in the non-distributed work-preview.tsx visual fixture. Generic UI Card is not the folder/item component.

status.implementation: Complete and installed through the registry CLI into an isolated consumer. Local candidate; publication and live host certification are separate gates.
status.assetDownloads: All provided SVG assets downloaded with curl as instructed by the design context. Root SVG dimensions inspected; paths were not redrawn or edited.
status.canonical: Assigned sources use canonical Tailwind candidates. The repository-wide registry:verify gate owns final canonical, generated-source integrity and consumer build validation.
status.format: Biome 2.4.16 formatted assigned TypeScript sources and preview.
status.browserVerification: Final production Chromium consumer: 50 state/property examples match live Figma geometry within 1/32 CSS pixel; 214 Aptos/Inter text samples use actual custom fonts; 18 screenshots and 17 callback/keyboard checks passed. All 16 family and 4 brand reference screenshots were manually compared; changed task/folder/table examples were rechecked after correction. Master-cell optional-property surface and equal text widths passed after the final fixture refresh. Raster antialiasing differs; pixel-byte equality is not claimed.

conventions.font: font-snapp-body resolves live Figma body-family token. Employee avatar explicitly uses Inter.
conventions.stroke: Figma inside strokes are inset rings where intrinsic layout must remain unchanged.
conventions.storage: No browser storage or data transport belongs to these UI components.
conventions.assets: Registry SVG imports target @/assets/snapp/{work,brand}/<hash>.svg. Preserve exact local SVG roots and natural geometry; no temporary Figma URL is used at runtime.

browserGate.scope: All named variants of the 16 assigned families, 4 brand assets, a master TableCell optional-property example and native callback/keyboard paths.
checks: 50 reference width/height pairs; Chromium 1/64 pixel layout quantization tolerated below 1/32 CSS pixel
214 text samples record family, size, weight, line-height, color and CDP actual font identity; all rendered glyphs require custom Aptos or Inter faces
Every image is loaded with nonzero natural dimensions, including root brand images
Master dual-text widths are equal; the Table instance explicitly uses compact primary text
17 callback and controlled-state checks include native keyboard completion and expansion
Geometry/font/asset evidence is saved before interactions so a callback failure cannot discard measurements
limits: Reference PNG comparisons are manual. Figma and browser font rasterization do not produce identical PNG bytes.
Optional property combinations use the live master context and individual measurements; the gate does not claim a Cartesian-product screenshot matrix.
Live Dynamics, Power Pages, PCF and Cabinet execution are not certified by this isolated consumer preview.

families.name: TaskListItem
families.purpose: Scheduled record tile for boards, calendars, compact lists and drag feedback.
families.interaction: Native time/menu buttons when callbacks supplied; consumers own record navigation and dragging.

families.name: Day
families.purpose: Calendar day cell containing scheduled TaskListItem children.
families.interaction: Caller supplies calendar state, date semantics and scheduled child records.

families.name: Work Item
families.purpose: Backlog work record with allocation, time and progress; distinct from scheduling tiles.
typography: Aptos 12/16 400 action, metadata, assignment, time and capacity
families.interaction: Existing WorkItem API preserved; optional assignments supports multiple booking lines. Consumers own mutations and drag behavior.

families.name: WorkOS Personal Productivity Right Panel
families.purpose: Focus and overdue summary panel with reusable record rows and controlled collapse.
typography: Aptos 14/20 400 labels, totals and row records
Headings and totals use text-brand #2f455c; nested Tree Item record identifiers and names use text-primary #2a2c2e (second-pass live Figma verification).
families.interaction: Native collapse toggle and optional row activation. Feature supplies lists and totals.

families.name: Achievements
families.purpose: Finished-work counts for the current week and month.
families.interaction: Read-only summary with caller-provided counts and localized labels.

families.name: CheckItem
families.purpose: Learning assignment summary with completion and issued date.
families.interaction: Controlled completion checkbox when onCompletedChange is supplied.

families.name: Course
families.purpose: Reorderable certification row with completion, issued date and overflow actions.
families.interaction: Native completion/overflow buttons and caller-provided drag-handle attributes. No domain queries.

families.name: EmployeeCard
families.purpose: Employee certification summary with progress, certification groups and optional-group expansion.
typography: Aptos 14/20 400 role, progress and expanded group labels
families.interaction: Controlled minimal/full and optional expansion. Slot content owns courses; counters are caller supplied. Progress defaults to completed / total and accepts an independently supplied progressPercentage clamped to 0–100; the accessible progressbar reports the same rendered value.
designNotes: The Figma course instances overflow the 312.5px card with 432.5px inner rows / 456px default rows. Preserved as a design fact; applications may deliberately override course widths for constrained layouts.
The second completed course instance is 22px high while neighboring rows are 32px. The visual fixture preserves that override.

The Figma progress geometry shows 64.84% despite its 2/3 counter. The reference fixture supplies that explicit design percentage; normal business usage keeps the derived ratio unless its domain owns a different percentage.
Header references non-token raw colors #0a0a0a, #4a5565, #364153 and progress #0073de. Preserved rather than silently remapping.

families.name: CourseStatus
families.purpose: Person/date course completion state with default, success, notice and warning tones.

families.name: TableCell
families.purpose: Reusable header/body cell content with optional icon, secondary text, chevron and sort action.
typography: Aptos 14/20 400, brand header / primary and secondary body
properties: primarySizing=fill preserves equal-width master text regions; content preserves compact record instance override
families.interaction: Header sort is a native button with aria-sort and caller-owned sorting.

families.name: TableRow
families.purpose: Semantic row composed from reusable cells.
families.interaction: Semantic tr; application owns row selection.

families.name: Table
families.purpose: Four-column record decision table example, implemented as a generic data table rather than embedding example records.
properties: Sample columns and rows -> columns, rows and getRowKey
families.interaction: Caller owns filtering, complete-result fetching, sorting and paging.
designNotes: Figma uses middle-aligned flex cells; shorter cells have white content backgrounds while taller neighboring cells leave transparent space. DataTable uses semantic cells with inner white content wrappers to retain that geometry.

families.name: InboxCategory
families.purpose: Selectable inbox category navigation with optional count.
families.interaction: Native navigation button with selected and disabled semantics.
designNotes: Figma declares a 24px wrapper around a 28px padded menu row; retained rather than changing the design.

families.name: InboxItem
families.purpose: Selectable message summary showing sender, category, priority, subject and preview.
typography: Aptos 11/12 400 initials, timestamp, category, priority and preview
families.interaction: Native selection button with aria-pressed; callers own inbox content.

families.name: ActionNode
families.purpose: Canvas action, condition or trigger node with selectable body and optional connection handlers.
families.interaction: Native selection and connection buttons; consuming canvas owns layout and connections.

families.name: Card
families.purpose: Folder group or individual service navigation card; distinct from the generic UI Card primitive.
families.interaction: Native navigation/action button with caller-supplied click handler.

followup: The final registry:verify gate passed after the last shared source change, including a fresh complete consumer install, strict types, production build and generated-file integrity. The work browser gate also passed with all corrections applied; see verification.json.
Publication and rollout use the registry-first engineering-hub process and remain separate from local candidate verification.
Intentional Figma overflow/instance overrides are recorded per family; do not silently label a constrained application variant as an exact reference reproduction.
